title: Same Scrutiny, More Time: Eye Tracking Insights into Reviewing LLM-Labelled Code
abstract: arXiv:2606.26505v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern software development increasingly involves the use of large language models (LLMs) to generate code. Despite their rapid advancement, LLMs remain prone to errors and hallucinations, emphasizing the importance of careful code inspection. However, in practice, developers' trust in LLM-generated code and their willingness to review it thoroughly may differ from these recommendations. How developers actually behave when reviewing LLM-generated code remains largely unexplored. In this study, we conduct a Wizard-of-Oz experiment to examine how software engineers behave when code is explicitly labeled as LLM-generated during a code review task. We collect both behavioral data and participant feedback through eye-tracking and exit interviews. Combining Bayesian data analysis with qualitative analysis, we found that while the thoroughness of code review did not change for participants, they spent more time fixating on LLM-labelled code

translated_title: 同样的审查，更多的时间：通过眼动追踪洞察对标注为LLM生成代码的审查
translated_abstract: 现代软件开发越来越涉及使用大型语言模型（LLM）来生成代码。尽管LLM发展迅速，但它们仍然容易出错和产生幻觉，这凸显了仔细检查代码的重要性。然而，在实践中，开发人员对LLM生成代码的信任程度以及他们彻底审查代码的意愿可能与这些建议有所不同。开发人员在审查LLM生成的代码时实际表现如何，在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本研究中，我们进行了一项“绿野仙踪”（Wizard-of-Oz）实验，以检验当代码审查任务中的代码被明确标记为LLM生成时，软件工程师的行为表现。我们通过眼动追踪和退出访谈收集了行为数据和参与者反馈。结合贝叶斯数据分析与定性分析，我们发现虽然参与者代码审查的彻底程度没有改变，但他们在被标记为LLM生成的代码上花费了更多的注视时间。
tldr: 本研究通过眼动追踪实验发现，当开发者审查被明确标注为LLM生成的代码时，虽然审查的彻底程度不变，但会在这些代码上花费更多的注视时间，揭示了代码来源标签对开发者审查行为的影响。
en_tdlr: This eye-tracking study found that when developers review code explicitly labeled as LLM-generated, they spend more time fixating on it while maintaining the same level of review thoroughness, revealing how code provenance labels influence developer review behavior.
